items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, with the biggest difference seen in walks of 10 to 19 minutes. You walked after 2 of your scored meals, which is too few to see how it affects you yet.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: Try not to have dinner too late, as sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners in the program. You didn't have any scored dinners that started at 8 pm or later, so keep up the good habit.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You're doing great with overnight fasting, averaging 15.9 hours and reaching 13 hours every night. In the program, adding overnight fasting to coaching changed some numbers, but it's not clear how it affects everyone yet.
